"""Plot actual solver paths and projected collision boxes for the selected navigator."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

root = Path('runs/quality-research')
geometry = json.loads((root / 'navigation-arena-geometry.json').read_text())
cases = json.loads((root / 'navigation-sequence-traces.json').read_text())
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 10), layout='constrained')
axes = axes.flatten()
for axis, case, title in zip(axes, cases, ['Update 180: finds the house window', 'Update 180: pipe route collision', 'Update 300: loses the house route', 'Update 300: finds the pipe entrance']):
    for block in geometry:
        if block['surface'] == 'Floor':
            continue
        centre, half, q = np.array(block['centre']), np.array(block['half']), np.array(block['rotation'])
        corners = []
        for sx in [-1, 1]:
            for sy in [-1, 1]:
                for sz in [-1, 1]:
                    local = half * [sx, sy, sz]
                    world = centre + local + 2 * np.cross(q[:3], np.cross(q[:3], local) + q[3] * local)
                    corners.append(world[[0, 2]])
        corners = np.array(corners)
        low, high = corners.min(axis=0), corners.max(axis=0)
        color = '#80979c' if block['surface'] == 'Pipe' else '#8e9293'
        axis.add_patch(Rectangle(low, *(high - low), color=color, alpha=0.18, linewidth=0.5))
    trace = case['trace']
    drone = np.array([sample['drone_metres'] for sample in trace])
    target = np.array([sample['target_metres'] for sample in trace])
    axis.plot(target[:, 0], target[:, 2], color='#bb741b', linestyle='--', label='Robot path', linewidth=1.5)
    axis.plot(drone[:, 0], drone[:, 2], color='#167b78', label='Drone path', linewidth=1.6)
    axis.scatter(drone[0, 0], drone[0, 2], color='#167b78', s=25, marker='o', label='Drone start')
    if case['ended']:
        axis.scatter(drone[-1, 0], drone[-1, 2], color='#ad302b', s=80, marker='x', linewidths=2, label='Collision')
    axis.set(title=title, xlabel='X (m)', ylabel='Z (m)', xlim=(-10, 10), ylim=(10, -7), aspect='equal')
    axis.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
    axis.grid(alpha=0.15)
axes[0].legend(frameon=True, facecolor='white', framealpha=0.95, fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
axes[1].legend(frameon=True, facecolor='white', framealpha=0.95, fontsize=8, loc='upper left')
fig.suptitle('Sequence imitation: successes and regressions at seed 42\nRobot remains behind cover. Native solver paths; not gameplay footage.\nProjected collision boxes do not show openings at height.', fontsize=12)
fig.savefig('docs/progress/drone-sequence-paths.png', dpi=130)
